result:
Perfect! I found the bug. The issue was in `tally/invoice.py:42`:

**The Problem:** The discount condition was checking `if self.units() > BULK_UNITS:` (strictly greater than), but it should check `if self.units() >= BULK_UNITS:` (greater than or equal).

This caused the test `test_bulk_discount_starts_at_ten_units()` to fail because an order with exactly 10 units wasn't receiving the bulk discount. The test name even makes this clear - the discount should **start at** 10 units (inclusive), not after 10 units.

The fix changed line 42 from `>` to `>=`, so now orders with 10 or more units will correctly receive the 5% bulk discount.
